rca of the issue: Bug: PUT /api/portfolio/holdings/{id} rejects {buy_date: null}. RCA: routes/portfolio.py line 106 uses Python dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in holding.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` which drops ALL null fields from the update payload, then line 107-108 throws 400 when the resulting dict is empty. Since Pydantic defaults unset optional fields to None in v2, this filter cannot distinguish 'client explicitly sent null to clear' from 'client did not send this field'. Fix: use `holding.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` instead — then nulls sent explicitly are preserved, and unsent fields are naturally excluded. Repro: `curl -X PUT .../api/portfolio/holdings/<id> -d '{"buy_date": null}'` → 400. Mitigation: apply Pydantic exclude_unset pattern across all PUT/PATCH handlers.
